chunks: And from him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"When the man rises from prostration, he says: 'By the power of Allah, I rise and I sit.'"
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication when rising from prostration in Shia prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the Sunnah of reciting 'Bi-hawlihi aqumu wa aq'ud' (By His power I stand and sit) upon rising from prostration, emphasizing the physical act as an act of divine reliance. In Shia jurisprudence, this is classified as a recommended (mustahabb) practice that reinforces the worshipper's awareness of Allah's enabling grace during the transitions of prayer. It reflects the broader theological principle that even mundane physical movements in worship are sustained by God's power.
